limitations: Overlapping multi-month return targets make forecast errors serially correlated; the effective sample is smaller than the fold count, so no statistical significance is claimed.
Adjusted historical Yahoo Finance closes can be retrospectively revised for corporate actions and are not a true institutional point-in-time vintage.
Enforcing strict label maturity drops early forecast dates where fewer than 24 matured training labels exist.

Controlled reimplementation, not an execution audit of ML Stock Simulator. The unpurged reference excludes the forecast row but retains immature prior labels; its features, AR(1) model, scaling, and forest settings differ from the predecessor. The original/corrected JSON keys are legacy identifiers.
